description: A large white and blue jumbo jet with a presidential seal sits on a dark theatre stage under spotlights. Lettering on the fuselage reads UNITED STATES OF AMERICA. A rack of dark uniform jackets stands at left, small flags and paper scraps lie on the wooden stage floor, and empty audience seats show at the bottom edge. Loose oil-paint style, filling the frame with no border.
reason: Legible lettering 'UNITED STATES OF AMERICA' is painted along the airliner's fuselage; repaint the plane without any writing.
